highlights_headline: The upcoming 4.155.0 release restores Linux system-font discovery and updates Tizen native packages for Tizen 10.
highlights_body: Linux applications using the NoDependencies packages can again discover fonts installed on the system, while Tizen consumers receive native assets built with the supported toolchain.

bullets.detail: NoDependencies deployments on Linux can again locate and use fonts installed on the host system.
Tizen native assets are now built and packaged with the Tizen 10 GCC 14.2 toolchain.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies deployments
